title: look i have some pages design prototypes right? in html?

messages.content: look i have some pages design prototypes right? in html?

Yes. They live in two places:

**`prototypes/`** — the tracked prototype system (registered + versioned + "settled" status, shown on the app's Protos page via `/api/protos`). Three of them, all currently `settled`:

- `prototypes/casino-settings/casino-settings.html` — module `casino_settings`. **This is your active one** — your last commits (`prototype chunk casino-settings c1 …`) are chunking it into Buildprint steps. Has `build-plan.json` + 4 chunk prompts in `prototypes/casino-settings/chunks/`.
- `prototypes/buttons/buttons.html` — module `user_management` (registered from `crs-brain/data/docs/buttons.html`).
- `prototypes/studio-sample/studio-sample.html` — module `user_management` (scaffolded from the cards template).

**`demos/`** — raw standalone HTML mockups, not tracked as protos:

- `demos/casino_property_settings.html` (the source the casino-settings proto was registered from) + a `(2)` variant
- `demos/CRS_BreakList.html`, `demos/CRS_Canvas.html`, `demos/CRS_Coming_Soon.html`

Plus the design reference `design/CRS_UI_Kit.html`.

What do you want to do with them — keep working the casino-settings chunks, register a demo as a new proto, or something else?
